title: Example Scheduler requirements
description: Fictional example of the Example Scheduler, a made-up job scheduler; not a description of any real system.

entities.title: No silent failures
entities.summary: A failed run always reaches the operator on duty.
entities.statement: When a job run fails, the operator on duty is alerted within five minutes.
entities.rationale: Silent failures are the reason the scheduler exists.
acceptanceCriteria: A failing test job raises an alarm within five minutes
The alarm names the job and the run
entities.origin: Vision: jobs run on time, and someone knows when they don't
